about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (packages/files): each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths only. A file named .held is the same bytes with its test name taken off so the repository test does not run it; the reason is under `held`. `not_carried` names package files that were left in the package and why.

not_carried.packages/files/.bitfield-entry-scope/fil: generated build output of the retired package runtime (entry scope, built entry bytes); not carried

not_carried.packages/files/entry-to-package-data-map: maps package entries to the retired package runtime's entry scope; not carried
not_carried.packages/files/things-to-store-and-run.j: the package boundary file: record contracts, actions and surfaces for the retired package runtime (slot workflows, owner targets); not carried
